title: Your November, booked in
headline: Your November, booked in
caption:
November starts on Sunday. Is your spot on the reformer saved? 🗓️

The darker months are when a plan really helps. Choose your classes now, and the hard part of the week is already done.

New to POWR? Lots of people come on their own, and you don't need to be flexible or fit to start. We'll show you everything when you arrive.

A single Reformer class is £18. If you'd like to build up gently, Reformer Foundations gives you 3 classes for £45.

November's Pilates classes in Clitheroe are on the timetable through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
source: Monthly themes: Late Oct 2026 (push the November timetable and class packs before the month starts). Weekly rhythm: Friday theme or offer. Playbook: first-class nerves + price. Known prices: £18 single, £45 Reformer Foundations.
